At the first frame the waggoner's head and shoulders fill the RIGHT half of the frame from his black hat at the TOP edge to the smock frock at the BOTTOM edge, his head a third of the frame's height. Ogilvy's shoulder and wild auburn hair fill the LEFT edge, dark against the lemon sky at the TOP LEFT. The camera keeps a locked-off frame over <Subject 2>'s shoulder toward <Subject 1> as <Subject 1> looks him up and down and shakes his head, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 he flicks the reins and the horse pulls the cart on along the road, and the pull continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:06 while he looks him up and down and shakes his head.
